description: Final curated 50-car manifest, one best candidate per vehicle selected from tools/asset-acquisition/hero_car_candidates.json plus targeted fixes for 3 bad primary picks found during this pass (a tag-list page, a category page, and the flagged DO_NOT_USE listing). NONE of these have been purchased or downloaded - status PURCHASE_REQUIRED means 'a plausible candidate was identified and needs manual purchase', not 'acquired'.
environmentNote: Built from a Claude Code remote session container with no payment method and no marketplace account access - purchasing is not something this environment can do. This manifest exists to make the manual purchase pass on your real machine fast and informed.
verificationMethodNote: 4 of 50 listings (BMW M4, M5, M8, M2) were individually fetched and read for real page content (poly counts, creator, partial license text) via WebFetch. The tool then began returning empty content for further Sketchfab pages in this session (consistent with rate-limiting, not a page-structure problem - curl confirmed the pages return real HTML). CGTrader and TurboSquid individual listing pages returned an empty HTTP 202 bot-challenge response even via curl with a browser User-Agent - genuinely unreachable for automated verification from this environment, not attempted to bypass. The remaining 46 entries carry search-snippet-level research only and are honestly marked as such in verificationNotes.
